Saving anyway is what I’d want. A private or temporarily unavailable page can still be worth bookmarking, so I should be able to enter the title and description myself and use a placeholder image.

Please make it clear that the page content was not preserved, rather than implying the placeholder is a saved copy. I’d also like a way to retry collecting the page details and saved copy later if the page becomes accessible. With that distinction, this behavior feels right.
